item.title: Legal Basement Finishing: Cutting Egress Windows in Poured Concrete, IRC R310 Codes & Slab Framing
item.description: Turning an unfinished basement into a legal bedroom or recreation room is the highest-ROI square footage addition in the Midwest. But building inspectors will red-tag any space without code-compliant emergency egress. We break down IRC Section R310 dimensions (5.7 sq ft net clear opening), diamond wet sawing through 8-inch reinforced concrete, structural steel lintel sizing, and why connecting window well drains to perimeter footing tiles prevents basement floods.
